question: Can length/slot profiles improve administrative mapping after a pooled transition score loses typed-slot distinctions?
outcome: Across 48 fresh systems and 384 conditions, twenty-symbol administrative recovery is 55/96 for linear slot assignment versus 25/96 for multistart graph mapping, paired gain 31.25 points with interval 21.875–41.667. Transition recovery instead favors graph mapping: 74/96 versus 0/96 at twenty symbols. All counts, scores, eight-symbol maxima and dual assignment bounds independently checked; 23 conditions retain tied code alternatives.
challenge: Pooled transitions and position profiles retain different distinctions. A selected assignment can have optimal score and unresolved or wrong identities.
remedy: Use fresh generated worlds, compare both families, verify linear optima, evaluate both scores on held-out records and preserve code-exclusion tie witnesses. Record post-outcome model-development status.
retry_when: A reference-only family selector, shared-length forms or a new observation model supplies an informative comparator.
